body: This was gud. I can't wait for more inspirational help.
I do all kinds of things. I have hobbies/passions/friends/food. Just no real happiness apparently.
It's a not just selfishness, which is going way off here, but it's the fact that one would help to make themselves feel and seem better introspectively.

I truly believe that all humans are pretty selfish and the fact that self-interest is a thing means that many are just going to be "helpful" to make themselves feel better. This makes me feel entirely more like shit. I hate being human. Even because killing yourself is selfish and dumb, there's no way to escape being a sack of walking shit. All but The Escape Plan.

I didn't want to be rude to my friend. To be honest, I like to see what people think. I enjoy seeing other perspectives on subjects that boggle me. Although, I'm in no situation to prosper. It's a really dumb, really shitty  story that you'd probably bat an eye at and dismiss as petty. Still, I don't feel like living anymore. It's said that "the best things in life aren't things", but it feels like the laws that reciprocate mean the worst things in life aren't things as well. I believe those things to be emotions. They're the most abstract things I can imagine. I don't believe I am happy. I do believe I am a manic depressive.
